description: Send a text message from one of your MeiSIM numbers to a US number. Sending must be enabled on your account and each number has a monthly allowance; a refusal tells you which. The answer means accepted by the carrier: a mobile line has no delivery receipt. The same text to more than three numbers from one line inside an hour is refused (carriers drop that as a broadcast); write to each person in their own words. Not for emergency services. Needs your API key.

message.description: The text to send, up to 800 characters.
